summary: First E2E run on EIBIL platform. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 46 pytest cases covering public, auth, PAN+duplicate-rejection, employee, employer, pending-KYC employer, billing (mock), admin (login+2FA+APIs), ledger integrity, role guards. ALL 46 PASS. Frontend: public pages render, employee priya@demo.in dashboard shows score 907, trend chart, 4 dimensions, verification checklist with masked PAN (ABCPS****K); employer hr@acmetech.in dashboard shows credits=25, trust=100, roster, pending verifications; all employer sub-pages load. Admin admin@eibil.in 2FA via devOtp works (devOtp displayed in yellow banner), all admin pages (users, employers, verification, fraud, score, disputes, cms, audit, settings, billing) load without error boundaries. Role guards enforced in both backend (403) and frontend (RoleRoute). PAN duplicate rejection works (ABCPS1234K already used). Ledger integrity verify endpoint returns valid=true. Reseed re-run cleanly.

minor.issue: OTP re-send cooldown of 30s is informed via UI only, backend returns new 2FA challenge with devOtp - no issue in behavior, but if automated test re-fires too fast the user sees 'Please wait 30 seconds' until the next window; acceptable UX.

rateLimiter uses req.ip without trust proxy - behind the preview proxy multiple clients may share the same forwarded IP and all share one bucket; cosmetic for preview, consider enabling trust proxy for production

issues: Light-mode only (per spec). Clean, readable contrast, consistent padding, red primary brand color. No contrast issues observed on employee/employer/admin dashboards.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/src/middleware/rateLimiter.js: validate.trustProxy=false even though the app runs behind the Python gateway + CF; limit buckets will collapse to a single key in production. Enable Express trust proxy and set trustProxy:true (or use req.ips[0]).

Auth 2FA UI input has data-testid on the wrapper (login-2fa-code), not on the actual <input>. Automation must click the wrapper and type via keyboard. Consider forwarding data-testid onto the real input for cleaner Playwright/axe tests.

verification/pan: duplicate PAN returns 400 with the generic 'Validation failed' message in some paths; consider 409 Conflict with explicit code for easier client handling (currently caller must string-match).
No obvious _id leaks observed in tested endpoints; good.

success_rate.frontend: ~100% - all tested pages load without error boundaries

test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin@eibil.in / Admin@12345 (with 2FA devOtp from UI), hr@acmetech.in / Demo@12345, hr@sahyadriinfra.in / Demo@12345, priya@demo.in / Demo@12345. Ran `node src/seeds/seed.js --reset` before testing.
seed_data_creation: Reseeded database via `cd /app/backend && node src/seeds/seed.js --reset` before each test run. Tests create ephemeral employee users (test_*, dup_*, pan_* prefixed emails) with unique mobile numbers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). All 46 pass. Admin 2FA login must click login-2fa-code wrapper then type OTP via keyboard (wrapper is not an <input>). devOtp displayed under [data-testid="dev-otp"]. Mobile numbers must be unique on each register call. The auth/otp limiters are strict (authLimiter 100/15min, 2FA code regen 30s cooldown) - add sleeps between rapid logins. Cloudflare preview occasionally shows a human-verify challenge after bursts of requests; wait 60-90s and retry. The register endpoint requires fields: email, password, name (not fullName), mobile, acceptTerms. devOtp lives at data.otp.devOtp (nested) for /register, at data.devOtp for /login 2FA.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. Only minor code-review feedback captured above.
